import re
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


_URL = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\"']+", re.IGNORECASE)


def extract_resource_links(text: str, suffix: str = ".seg") -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not isinstance(suffix, str):
        raise TypeError("text and suffix must be strings")
    if len(suffix) < 2 or not suffix.startswith("."):
        raise ValueError("suffix must start with a dot and have a body")

    found = []
    for match in _URL.finditer(text):
        candidate = match.group(0).rstrip(".,;:!?)}}")
        try:
            parsed = urlsplit(candidate)
            hostname = parsed.hostname
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if hostname and parsed.path.lower().endswith(suffix.lower()):
            found.append(candidate)
    return found

import unittest

from solution import extract_resource_links


class ExtractResourceLinksTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_text(self):
        self.assertEqual(extract_resource_links(""), [])

    def test_http_https_order_duplicates_and_case_insensitive_suffix(self):
        first = "http://example.com/a.seg"
        second = "HTTPS://cdn.example.org/path/B.SEG?token=1#part"
        text = f"{first} then {second} and again {first}"
        self.assertEqual(extract_resource_links(text), [first, second, first])

    def test_candidate_delimiters_are_not_included(self):
        text = (
            "<http://a.example/one.seg> "
            "'https://b.example/two.seg' "
            '"http://c.example/three.seg"'
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            extract_resource_links(text),
            [
                "http://a.example/one.seg",
                "https://b.example/two.seg",
                "http://c.example/three.seg",
            ],
        )

    def test_all_documented_trailing_punctuation_is_stripped(self):
        punctuation = ".,;:!?)]}"
        expected = []
        pieces = []
        for index, character in enumerate(punctuation):
            url = f"https://example.com/{index}.seg"
            expected.append(url)
            pieces.append(url + character)
        self.assertEqual(extract_resource_links(" ".join(pieces)), expected)

    def test_query_fragment_preserved_but_path_controls_suffix(self):
        valid = "https://example.com/file.seg?download=.txt#section"
        invalid_query_only = "https://example.com/file.txt?name=.seg"
        invalid_fragment_only = "https://example.com/file.txt#name.seg"
        self.assertEqual(
            extract_resource_links(f"{valid} {invalid_query_only} {invalid_fragment_only}"),
            [valid],
        )

    def test_custom_suffix(self):
        text = "http://example.com/A.DATA https://example.com/b.seg"
        self.assertEqual(extract_resource_links(text, ".data"), ["http://example.com/A.DATA"])

    def test_missing_hostname_and_malformed_candidates_are_ignored(self):
        text = "http:///file.seg http://[broken/file.seg https://example.com/not-seg.txt"
        self.assertEqual(extract_resource_links(text), [])

    def test_argument_validation(self):
        for text, suffix in [(None, ".seg"), ("text", None), (b"text", ".seg")]:
            with self.subTest(text=text, suffix=suffix):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    extract_resource_links(text, suffix)

        for suffix in ["", ".", "seg", "dot.seg"]:
            with self.subTest(suffix=suffix):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    extract_resource_links("", suffix)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
